description: This file defines a static utility class 'Slug' with methods to generate URL-friendly slugs from input strings, including normalization, character filtering, and trimming.

classes.name: Slug
classes.description: A static class providing methods to generate URL slugs from strings.

methods.name: GenerateSlug
methods.description: Generates a URL-friendly slug from the input string by normalizing, removing invalid characters, collapsing spaces, trimming to max length, and replacing spaces with hyphens.
